info.title: Kaibil Football League Manager API
info.description: REST API for the Kaibil Football League Manager. All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/v1`. Most endpoints require a Bearer access token obtained from `/auth/login` or `/auth/register`. Admin-only routes are marked with the **ADMIN** badge in their description.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, refresh, logout, current user

tags.name: Leagues
tags.description: Leagues and their associated fields (ADMIN-only mutations)

bearerAuth.description: Paste the `accessToken` returned by `/auth/login` or `/auth/register` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

refreshTokenCookie.name: kaibil_rt
refreshTokenCookie.description: HttpOnly refresh-token cookie set automatically by `/auth/login`, `/auth/register` and `/auth/refresh`. Swagger UI cannot send cookies, so use Postman (which has cookie support) for those endpoints.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated user lacks the required role

UserRole.description: Role assigned at registration. Determines access to admin endpoints.

User.description: Public user representation (no password hash, internal file paths).

AuthSuccess.description: Returned by register, login and refresh. The refresh token is also set as an HttpOnly cookie.

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on protected routes.

refreshToken.description: Opaque token. Normally delivered as the `kaibil_rt` HttpOnly cookie; the body copy is informational.

SuccessEnvelope.description: Standard success response wrapper used by every endpoint.

password.description: Minimum 8 chars, at least one letter and one digit.

UpdateUserRequest.description: Partial update. Extra fields are rejected (`.strict()`).

UpdateFieldRequest.description: Partial update of a field. Only provided keys are changed.

UpdateLeagueRequest.description:
Partial update. When `fieldIds` is provided it **replaces** the league's
associated fields (empty array removes all). `startDate` must be `<= endDate`
when both are set.

patch.description:
Partial update. Unknown fields are rejected. If `birthDate` changes,
`age` is recomputed server-side.

post.description:
Accepts a single image file under the form-data field name `file`.
Allowed MIME types: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`.
Max size is `MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB` (default 10 MB). The image is
processed (resize/convert) and stored under `uploads/users/<id>/`.

200.description: Photo accepted. Returns the updated user with `profilePhotoUrl`.

400.description: Missing file, wrong MIME type, or file too large.

200.description: Photo removed. Returns the updated user.
Photo accepted. Returns the updated user with `coverPhotoUrl`.

400.description: Missing file, wrong MIME type, or file too large.

200.description: Photo removed. Returns the updated user.

get.description: Returns active (non-soft-deleted) leagues ordered by `isActive DESC, name ASC`. Pass `includeInactive=true` to also see soft-deleted ones.

post.description: **ADMIN only.** Every `fieldId` must reference an existing, non-soft-deleted field.

patch.description:
**ADMIN only.** Partial update. If `fieldIds` is provided, it **replaces**
the entire set of associated fields atomically. `startDate` must be
`<= endDate` when both are set.

400.description: Validation error, unknown `fieldId`, or invalid date range.

get.description: Returns active (non-soft-deleted) fields by default. Pass `includeInactive=true` to also see soft-deleted ones.

post.description: **ADMIN only.** Name must be unique among active fields.

409.description: A field with that name already exists.
A field with the new name already exists.

delete.description: **ADMIN only.** Sets `deletedAt`; the field is hidden from default listings but preserved in the database.

post.description:
Creates a user account and immediately returns access + refresh tokens.
The refresh token is also set as an HttpOnly cookie (`kaibil_rt`).
Rate-limited more aggressively than other endpoints.

401.description: Invalid credentials, inactive user, or soft-deleted account.

post.description:
Reads the `kaibil_rt` HttpOnly cookie, revokes the old refresh token,
and issues a fresh pair (access + refresh). Triggers global logout if
a previously-revoked token is replayed.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or replayed refresh token.

post.description:
If the `kaibil_rt` cookie is present, the corresponding refresh token
is revoked. Always clears the cookie. Safe to call when not logged in.

200.description: Logged out (no-op if there was no active session).
